# Wharf 0.7.0 implementation review

## Status

Implementation is validated for release.

## Findings

- Base preparation, context preparation, and derived builds share one
  coordinator semaphore and cannot exceed `B`.
- Cache keys are deterministic and include all build inputs.
- Identical normal requests coalesce while in flight and reuse successful
  results afterward.
- Force builds bypass and do not populate the normal cache.
- Caller cancellation does not cancel a shared operation or poison later
  callers.
- Failed operations are removed from the in-flight map and can be retried.
- Docker execution remains behind an injectable backend boundary; no agent or
  verifier container execution was introduced.

## Validation evidence

`dotnet format wharf.slnx --verify-no-changes` passed and the Release test
suite passed all 40 tests.
